Chapter 468: Chapter 11: Dragon Palace in Hand (Subscribe Please)_2

“`

“Two tenths is too low,” said the unicorn man, his face somewhat unsightly.

In the end,

the two parties decided to split the essence of the heavenly water, with Huailong Palace taking six tenths and the Heavenly Dragon Nest taking four tenths.

“With our two great forces joining hands, that Daode Immortal Sect, that Xuanwang Domain, are nothing but chickens and dogs,” the unicorn man said with a smile on his face.

The Huailong Palace Master was also in a good mood.

...

Although he had given away four tenths of the essence of the heavenly water for nothing,

with the promise of the full support of the Heavenly Dragon Nest,

the confidence of Huailong Palace greatly increased, enough to deal with the oppression from the surrounding great realms’ Half-Step Immortal Kings.

Just as the unicorn man was about to return to the Heavenly Dragon Nest to report the matter to the Dragon Lord,

his expression suddenly changed.

The Huailong Palace Master did the same, abruptly looking up to the sky.

They saw the vast and boundless sky dimming unexpectedly.

It wasn’t dimming—it was a huge hand, black and white, that had enshrouded the entire Huailong Palace.

“Who dares to be so presumptuous in front of my Huailong Palace?”

One by one, the True Immortal-level dragon descendants soared into the sky, attempting to shatter the hand that blocked out the sun.

However, their True Immortal-level destructive spells fell on that enormous hand, failing to stir even a ripple.

Thunderous booms.

The enormous hand slowly descended, its fingers beginning to close, as if it was about to lift the Huailong Palace covering hundreds of thousands of miles.

The sound of rushing water.

The Huailong Palace Master transformed into a ten-thousand-foot true dragon directly, and the terrifying bloodline power suppressed all sides, hurtling towards the giant hand.

A Half-Step Immortal King who had transcended the Bodily Tribulation was naturally adept at fighting, not to mention possessing a True Dragon bloodline. Such a strike— even a Half-Step Immortal King like the Cangqing Immortal would not dare to confront it head-on, choosing instead to flee far away.

However,

in the face of the slowly descending enormous hand, the full-force blow of the Huailong Palace Master had no effect at all, not even slightly delaying the hand’s descent.

From a great distance away, one could see that the entire Huailong Palace was not even a tenth of the size of the giant hand; the Huailong Palace Master, a Half-Step Immortal King true dragon, appeared like a mere insect in front of it.

“This is bad.”

The Huailong Palace Master’s face drastically changed, turning back into human form, attempting to retreat explosively, to leave the range of the giant hand’s shadow.

The fact that her full-force strike could not shake the hand at all made her realize she had no chance of stopping the hand.

Thunderous booms.

The Huailong Palace Master tried to use the power of space to teleport, but found that within the range of the hand, space had solidified, making it extremely difficult to even fly normally, let alone teleport.

Whoosh.

Realizing this, the Huailong Palace Master didn’t hesitate to return to the Huailong Palace below.

At this point, the only option was to resist the heavenly hand using the palace that connected to the core water vein of the Jiujang Domain.

A series of cracking sounds.

The heavenly giant hand continued to tighten, and one by one, the barriers formed by the water veins shattered, powerless to resist.

Finally, the entire Huailong Palace was directly uprooted by the giant hand.

The hum of spatial energy.

The heavenly giant hand and the abducted Huailong Palace vanished.

They left behind a huge crater hundreds of thousands of miles wide, which existed where the dominating force of the Jiujang Domain, Huailong Palace, once stood.

A moment later.

A man in a golden dragon robe appeared outside the huge crater.

Eyes wide and mouth agape, he looked at everything in front of him.

What happened?

How could the Huailong Palace have disappeared?

This man in the golden dragon robe was none other than the Dragon Lord of the Heavenly Dragon Nest.

The instant the heaven-covering giant hand appeared, its residual waves were the first to alert him.

So he was the first to arrive.

But upon arrival, he witnessed a scene he would never forget in his lifetime.

How could such a massive Huailong Palace disappear right under the nose of the Jiujang Domain?

How is that even possible?!

The disbelief of the Golden-Robed Dragon Lord was palpable. The Huailong Palace was merged with the water vein; an attack on the Huailong Palace was equivalent to attacking the core water vein of the Jiujang Domain.

Just this fact alone was something that a Unity Path Stage True Immortal could not achieve, nor could a Half-Step Immortal King.

Not to mention uprooting the entire Huailong Palace in such a short period; it was utterly unbelievable.

“`

“`

“Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King…” the Golden-Robed Dragon Lord’s thoughts quivered, the only being capable of doing this was the high and mighty Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King.

In the core of Dongyun Tao Province’s Great Realm, where Celestial King’s artifacts were used for suppression, relying solely on Celestial King’s artifacts might indeed breach Huailong Palace, but was also not enough to do so as crisply and cleanly as it had happened now.

“Has Huailong Palace offended a Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King?”

Fear gripped the heart of the Golden-Robed Dragon Lord, for as one of the Dominant forces of the Jiujang Domain, if he had offended a Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King, would it potentially implicate the Jiujang Domain?

Or even implicate his own Heavenly Dragon Nest?

Since that mysterious Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King could cause such a grand Huailong Palace to disappear, it indicated that he could make the Heavenly Dragon Nest disappear as well.

In essence, there was no difference between Huailong Palace and the Heavenly Dragon Nest; the only variation was their locations.

Whoosh.

Whoosh.

Whoosh.

One True Immortal after another from the Jiujang Domain appeared before the huge pit, looking at the dark chasm, their hearts turned cold.

The conclusions drawn by the Golden-Robed Dragon Lord could also be inferred by most True Immortals, for to render Huailong Palace so powerless, incapable of any struggle, only the Tribulation-Transcending Celestial Kings who overlooked the Spirit Realm could do that.

“What should we do?”

“Which Celestial King did Huailong Palace actually offend?”

“This Huailong Palace really deserves to die; offending a Celestial King is bad enough, but what if it implicates us?”

“No way, no way, I’ve decided to relocate to another Great Realm; the Jiujang Domain is too dangerous now, under the watch of a certain Celestial King.”

“I’m also relocating, let’s do it together.”

…

The True Immortals of the Jiujang Domain conversed among themselves, and many were planning to abandon their nests that they had operated for many years within the Jiujang Domain.

Although living in the Jiujang Domain had been quite comfortable, what did that comfort amount to when compared with their own lives?

They certainly did not wish to one day disappear suddenly like Huailong Palace did.

…..

Outside the Martial Temple Hall.

The Cangqing Immortal intently watched Lin Yuan’s outstretched right hand.

Palm faced downwards, he gently grasped.

The next moment,

Lin Yuan drew back his right hand, and the palm, previously facing downward, was now facing up.

The Cangqing Immortal blinked his eyes and suddenly realized that Lin Yuan’s previously empty palm now somehow held a palace.

The palace was extremely exquisite, and subtly, terrifying powers flowed between the eaves and walls of the palace.

“This palace, why does it look so familiar?”

The Cangqing Immortal’s mind couldn’t quite catch up, only feeling that the palace that had appeared in Lin Yuan’s palm was strangely familiar.

He had definitely seen it somewhere before.

Roar.

A series of tiny roaring sounds emerged from within the palace.

Inside the palace, several tiny worms were trapped, as if bound by an invisible force, never able to burst out of the palace’s confines.

The Cangqing Immortal’s eyes widened the more he looked.

If this palace were to be magnified a billion times, and those tiny worms as well, one would find that this palace was exactly the same as the Huailong Palace.

And those tiny worms turned out to be the True Immortals of dragon descent from Huailong Palace, especially that white ‘worm’, which, in terms of size and presence, surpassed all other ‘worms’ by a great deal; it was none other than the Bodily Tribulation-transcended Master of Huailong Palace.

Once, this Half-Step Immortal King who had been such a headache for the Cangqing Immortal and even considered a great concern by the Xuanwang Hall, was now trapped within the palace, like a true reptile.

“This…”

The Cangqing Immortal’s gaze was vacant,

Suddenly, a thought flashed through his mind, a phrase Lin Yuan had said earlier—

“Just directly capture it.”

At the time, the Cangqing Immortal thought Lin Yuan planned to send his followers to capture the core dragon descendants of Huailong Palace to be questioned.

As a Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King, Lin Yuan must have gathered some trusted subordinates.

With the addition of several Celestial King’s artifacts and other means, pressuring the many dragon descendants of Huailong Palace to surrender should not be a problem.

However, the Cangqing Immortal was also puzzled; this action did not seem as swift as personally delivering Lin Yuan’s Celestial King’s Decree to command Huailong Palace.

But since it was the Martial Ancestor’s will, the Cangqing Immortal dared not ask too much.

However,

Upon seeing that ‘miniature’ Huailong Palace in Lin Yuan’s hand, the Cangqing Immortal realized that Lin Yuan’s “Just directly capture it,” meant exactly what the words suggested, without any implication or metaphor.

He captured the entire Huailong Palace, the multitude of True Immortal dragons—

With a single grasp.
